positions.title: Engineering Career Services Peer Career Coach
Academic Tutor - Academic Coaching in Engineering (ACE)
positions.description: •	Tutor around 15 students in Engineering Calculus 2-4 times a week, write weekly lesson plans, and create worksheets.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant - Department of Engineering Education
positions.description:
•	Interpreted qualitative data using multiple coding approaches to identify patterns between participants and groups of individuals.
•	Determined existing patterns within and between participants in the different groups.
•	Presented research findings within the research group every week.

positions.title: Program Mentor - Louis Stokes Alliances for Minority Participation (LSAMP)
positions.description:
•	Guided transfer students during the transition process to OSU. 
•	Tailored semester plan to student’s objectives in order to succeed in and out of the classroom.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant at the Manufacturing and Materials Joining Innovation Center
positions.description:
• 	Collaborated with faculty and graduate students at the Manufacturing and Materials Joining and Innovation Center (M2JIC).
• 	Mechanical preparation of materialographic samples and weld inspection using microscopic examination.
•	Conducted Nickel based button melting for more than 10 hours to aid on cast pin tear testing.
•	Performed cast pin tear testing on Nickel-base filler metals.
•	Executed hardness, tensile, and bend testing on X60-X100 steel following ASME BPVC.IX standards.

positions.title: Global Supply Chain Planning IT Intern
positions.description:
- Decreased repetitive work by 92% to drive overall Technical Delivery of current and future Product Team implementation projects.
- Delivered and validated documentation for end-to-end Technical Delivery process of new application implementations.
- Coordinated with regional and global project managers to work cross-functionally with software, product, and planning teams to align the project scope.
positions.insights: Skills: Agile Project Management · Blue Prism · Microsoft Visual Studio Code · Communication

positions.title: Global Supply Chain Planning IT Intern
positions.description:
•	Designed and developed visualization solution that can be easily expanded to other businesses to reduce support response time.
•	Consulted with clients and internal stakeholders to gather requirements and plan milestones in the research, development, and implementation phases of the project lifecycle.
•	Created backend databases and automated the data generation process to save 7 work hours a week on average.
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft Power BI · Microsoft Power Automate · Tableau · Knime

positions.title: Quality Engineering Co-Op
positions.description:
•	Assisted the Customer Quality Assurance, Supplier Quality Improvement, Quality Management System and Early Life Failure (ELF) teams within the quality department.
•	Led part tracking project to see what information is and is not being captured, which will help with quality spills.
	 •        Ensured that suppliers are meeting requirements and part prints are correct according to the engineering team.
•	Actively worked on quality campaigns to meet customer expectations.

positions.title: Sales Associate
positions.description:
• Assisted 50+ customers per day so they can have a more than satisfactory experience.
• In charge of department inventory and upcoming freight. 
• Responded to telephone inquiries by providing quality service to internal and external customers, associates, and other Home Depot stores.
• Aided across different store departments.
• Learned the company’s product offerings in-store and online and contributed to an increase in monthly sales.
• Presented different approaches to customers' projects.

positions.title: Systems Engineer Intern - Cybersecurity
positions.description:
• Utilized the Java language for Android Development to create a background service that monitors running software every 15 minutes to prevent possible code tampering.
• Implemented agile project management by facilitating sprint planning and team leading standups.
• Learned Git software to communicate with Azure DevOps server and maintain project organization.

positions.title: Industrial Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Increased warehouse capacity by upgrading racking system reducing company spending by $120,000/mo & improved single and double stacked pallet positions by 25% and 72.95% respectively.
• Established standard time of finished goods which facilitated production flow.
• Designed warehouse layout to optimize the overall shipping process.

honors.title: Summer 2021 Dean's List
honors.description: Earned above a 3.5 GPA in the College of Engineering and have 12 or more graded credit hours.
honors.issuer: Issued by The Ohio State University · Aug 2021

honors.title: LSAMP Scholar Award

honors.issuer: Issued by The Ohio LSAMP Alliance · Apr 2021

projects.title: Project Lead The Way (PLTW)
projects.description: Introduction to Engineering Design and Principles of Engineering coursework completed.

projects.title: FIRST Tech Challenge
projects.description: Participated in the FIRST Tech Challenge 2014-2015 season at Rolla, Missouri. Assisted with the building and design process of the robot which had to race in an obstacle course
